proof: A second owner acquires the session lease while a run executes under the old generation: the loop stops at its next boundary with RunFenced and RunSuspended, the task waits naming the superseded generation and the owner, no turn/step/dispatch/outcome lands after the takeover (every state-advancing append is fenced at commit time), the stale owner's StartTask is refused STALE_LEASE and the new owner resumes the run under its generation to completion.
audit: PARTIAL before: commands were fenced (M1) but the agent loop carried no generation and kept advancing state after a takeover.
limitations: Local lease only (cloud lease with expiry/heartbeat is M8); a model call in flight at lease loss completes at the provider but its result is not applied.
